text:
elaine_cs: FYI — Hawthorn onboarding health check showed rising p95 latency and higher token cost on chat completions for v2.0. Want to propose proactive perf play: compact quant swap + routing to warm-dedicated pool. Thoughts? :mag:
aj_infra: Can you paste the metric snapshot? p95 and qps numbers will help. Also any error spikes? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
elaine_cs: Quick numbers: p95 = 1.2s -> 1.9s over last 24h, avg tokens/req ~430, qps ~4. No error surge, just tail latency. Customer is on hosted tier but close to committed volume for Dedicated upsell.
priya_se: Sounds like classic KV cache miss tail. If we can reduce model footprint with int8 quant for chat model it should lower kernel latency. Tradeoff check: quality runbook + a small eval set from Hawthorn (10 prompts) would verify. I can own eval.
sam_ops: Routing idea: route 70% -> compact-int8 variant in us-west-2 dedicated pool, 30% fallback to current hosted model. Canary over 2h with gradual ramp. If perf looks good, flip. We should also enable prefix caching for persistent sessions.
elaine_cs: @priya_se can you run the eval today? I'll notify the account of tentative canary window Tues 10am PT. Hawthorn product team is ok with short canary.
priya_se: Will run eval. Quick heads-up: need prompt set + expected outputs. Elaine — can you ask them for 10 representative convo turns (no PII) by EOD?
elaine_cs: Yep sending a small ask now. Also capturing feedback: they mentioned hallucination tolerance is low, so we should avoid aggressive quant if it worsens correctness.
aj_infra: Routing snippet for the console I suggest:
```
route_policy:
  - weight: 70
    model: rwd-chat-2.0-int8
    pool: dedicated-usw2-warm
  - weight: 30
    model: rwd-chat-2.0
    pool: hosted-global
max_latency_ms: 2000
```
ops-bot: Canary scheduled by sam_ops. 2h window, gradual ramp 0%->70% over 30min. Monitoring: p50/p95 latency, token cost, quality eval pass rate.
sam_ops: I'll create the canary config and alerting. If p95 < 1.3s and eval pass rate >= 90% we promote. If hallucination regressions >5% revert automatically.
elaine_cs: Assigning tasks: priya -> run eval + share results; sam -> create canary + alerts; aj -> pre-warm dedicated pool and validate kernel configs. I'll draft customer note.
priya_se: Eval done: 10 prompts -> int8 avg similarity 0.98, 1/10 minor formatting diff, no factual regressions. I'll attach results in thread when I send the artifact.
sam_ops: Canary configs pushed. Pre-warming dedicated nodes now. ETA 45m. I'll post the CID when ready.
elaine_cs: Customer note:
"Hey team — we plan a short performance canary Tue 10am PT: 70% traffic on a compact int8 variant routed to a warm dedicated pool for 2 hours. Monitoring p95 latency and quality. Expect improved latency and reduced token cost. Please flag any anomalies." :email:
aj_infra: Pre-warm done. Kernel selection set to fast-attn path for int8. Also enabled prefix caching TTL=30m for session tokens.
ops-bot: Canary started at 3299990200. Monitoring active.
sam_ops: Canary halfway (30m): p95 = 1.1s, token cost -28%, eval pass rate 100% so far. No errors.
elaine_cs: Awesome. I'll follow up with Hawthorn PM and loop legal for Dedicated upsell paperwork. Feel free to mark this thread when we flip.
priya_se: Uploading eval artifacts now.
ops-bot: Canary completed at 3299990360. Outcome: success. Auto-promote condition met.
sam_ops: Promoted the int8 variant as primary for the dedicated pool. Rolling changes noted.
elaine_cs: Thanks team — I'll capture this as a proactive optimization in the account playbook and propose a renewal note highlighting improved economics. :sparkles:
